item.title: [MEDIUM] Yoba malware spread via fake ChatGPT and Claude desktop apps on GitHub
item.description: Check Point Research reports a two-month campaign (Yoba) using fake GitHub projects posing as AI desktop apps (GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus), placing malware beside legitimate signed OpenAI and Anthropic executables for DLL sideloading; the observed final payload was an XMRig cryptominer, though the loader can deliver any payload. Target: Users seeking ChatGPT and Claude desktop apps. Global. Verification: reported.
